posts.title: Spravato: The FDA-Approved Nasal Spray That Can Lift Depression in Hours
posts.excerpt: Esketamine works on a completely different pathway than traditional antidepressants — and for some patients, relief arrives in hours rather than weeks.
posts.body:
## A different pathway

Most antidepressants act on serotonin, norepinephrine or dopamine, and they take four to eight weeks to show their full effect. Esketamine — the active ingredient in Spravato — works on the glutamate system instead, and that difference is why relief can arrive so much faster.

## Who it is for

Spravato is indicated for adults with treatment-resistant depression and for depressive symptoms in adults with major depressive disorder and acute suicidal ideation or behaviour.

- You have tried at least two antidepressants without adequate relief
- You need faster relief than a standard medication trial allows
- You can attend a certified treatment centre for monitored dosing

## What a session looks like

Spravato is self-administered as a nasal spray under supervision at a certified REMS centre. You stay for two hours of monitoring afterwards, and you will need a ride home.

> Patients often describe the first session as the first time in months that the weight lifted — even briefly.

Talk to our team about whether Spravato belongs in your treatment plan.

posts.title: ADHD in Women and Girls: Why It Goes Undiagnosed for Decades
posts.excerpt: Inattentive-type ADHD rarely looks like the hyperactive boy in the classroom. Here is what it actually looks like — and why so many women reach adulthood without a diagnosis.
posts.body:
## Why the diagnosis gets missed

Inattentive-type ADHD does not announce itself. Instead of the disruptive classroom behaviour clinicians were trained to look for, it shows up as daydreaming, disorganisation, and a private sense of falling behind.

- Symptoms are internalised rather than acted out
- Girls learn to mask early, often by over-preparing
- Anxiety and depression get diagnosed first, and treated alone

> By the time many women reach my office, they have spent twenty years assuming they were simply bad at being organised.

## What assessment actually involves

A proper evaluation looks backwards as well as forwards: school reports, childhood patterns, and a structured symptom history — not a five-minute questionnaire.

| Stage | What we look at |
| --- | --- |
| History | Childhood patterns, school records, family history |
| Screening | Standardised rating scales for adult ADHD |
| Differential | Thyroid, sleep, anxiety, mood, trauma |

## Treatment that fits the whole picture

Medication helps most patients, but it works far better alongside structure: externalised planning, sleep repair, and treating any co-occurring anxiety at the same time.
